sources.label: Panoramata home
sources.claim: Panoramata also tracks marketing emails, SMS, and flows on higher tiers, beyond ads and landing pages.

sources.label: Panoramata website-change tracking
sources.claim: Panoramata combines competitor ads, landing pages (desktop and mobile), website changes, and a versioned screenshot archive.

sources.label: Panoramata Meta ads tracking
sources.claim: Panoramata tracks competitor Meta ads as part of its ads-plus-pages product.

sources.label: Panoramata pricing page
sources.claim: Public list prices run from €99 a month (Startup, 20 competitors) to €379 (Advanced); Professional is listed at €149; a 6-month archive is listed on Startup and unlimited history on Professional.
